% Pictures that need a conversion or that lie outside the document's folder.
% Each must be a file inside the page's folder, named by a src that does not
% leave it, and nothing is written outside the build and page folders.
% PDF pictures: without and with the extension, starred, a page of a
% two-page PDF, in a subfolder by name and by \graphicspath, with a space in
% the name, with options, in a figure with a caption, in a minipage, in a
% footnote, and in a link. EPS pictures, converted by Ghostscript. Pictures
% named with ../ (by \graphicspath, by name, two levels up, the same name in
% two parent folders, a name with a space, PNG, JPEG, PDF, and EPS), the same
% picture twice, an import.sty chapter, an \import from a parent folder, and
% epsfig. A picture inside the folder is a guard. run.mjs builds this page
% again with \PdfpicAbsolute set to an absolute path of a picture.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{epsfig}
